steps: EXCLUDE organic mimics first (ACS, PE, arrhythmia, hypoglycaemia, thyrotoxicosis) - especially on first presentation.
Acute: calm reassurance, breathing techniques; benzodiazepines only sparingly/short-term if at all.
First-line ongoing treatment: CBT and/or an SSRI/SNRI.
Reduce stimulants (caffeine), alcohol; lifestyle and psychoeducation.
Arrange follow-up and safety-net; screen for depression and substance use.

confirm: Abrupt episodes of intense fear with somatic symptoms (palpitations, dyspnoea, chest tightness, paraesthesia) peaking within minutes - a diagnosis of exclusion after ruling out organic causes.
